liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Keith played a PolyMoog synthesizer alongside piano on Estimated Prophet that spring, as seen in April Capitol videos [7]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Recommends the Playin' sandwich, Terrapin Station, and the Estimated Prophet into Eyes of the World sequence [4]
- **China Doll** (1 other source): Uploader calls the Franklin's Tower into Space into China Doll sequence stellar [2]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Band entered Not Fade Away at roughly double the usual tempo and handled it remarkably well [13]
- **Playin' in the Band Reprise** (1 review): The Playin' reprise went extremely quiet, nearly fading into complete silence [13]

## The recordings

- **gd77-06-04.bertrando.goodbear.3417.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 25 songs; 181 min; rated 4.08/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the audience recording nice sounding; Reviewer says this copy lacks Promised Land and Lazy Lightning, and a loud talker intrudes during Peggy-O; Recording has audible yellers; band sounds slightly over-amped and somewhat sloppy [4][8][10][13]
- **gd1977-06-04.fob.menke.motb-0096.97183.flac16**: source not stated; 25 songs; 185 min; rated 4.73/5 by 15 [2]. Said about its sound: Talkers are audible during the first set [15]
- **gd1977-06-04.fob.menke.motb-0096.97140.flac24**: source not stated; 25 songs; 185 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [3]

## Around the show

- A talker kept up a conversation through the opening minute or two of Peggy-O [4]
- First show back in California after the long spring eastern tour; band sounded tired in set one [5]
- Reviewer attended with Ray Augustine and says they arrived late [9]
- A crowd member kept yelling for China Cat Sunflower, which the band would not play for about six months [10]
- First set had less energy than the Winterland shows a few days later; second set from Terrapin on caught fire [5]
- Band had just finished the landmark May run on the East Coast and seemed eager to impress at home [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd77-06-04.bertrando.goodbear.3417.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Rob Bertrando; source: Audience Recording: AKG D224Es [1]. Also: Reviewer recalls the show originally circulating from a small, cheap deck recorded by John, copied widely by young fans; Rob Bertrando taped with AKG D224E mics into a Sony TC-153 cassette deck, then DAT and SHN transfers [1][9]
- **gd1977-06-04.fob.menke.motb-0096.97183.flac16**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by Derek McCabe; source: 2 x AKG 224E => Sony TC-158SD >> MAC [2]. Also: This Menke MOTB version improves on the only other source, another audience tape; Bertrando's 18th row front-of-board tape was patched out; Menke transfer with no crossfades applied; Tape flips occur at the end of Eyes into Drums, and at the end of Franklin's Tower before Space [2][15]
- **gd1977-06-04.fob.menke.motb-0096.97140.flac24**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by Derek McCabe; source: 2 x AKG 224E => Sony TC-15XSD >> MAC [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by rocktourdatabase.com: [Grateful Dead | rocktourdatabase.com](https://rocktourdatabase.com/concerts/grateful-dead-840) [20]
